name: Feature request
description: A new defensive layer, a new piece of the pipeline, or a missing capability.
labels: ["needs-triage"]
---

## What you want

<!-- One-paragraph description. "A new thing" is not enough;
"I want a CLI flag to override the beamformer's sub-frame count
because the venue's reverb tail is 250 ms and 4 frames is too
short" is. -->

## Why

<!-- The motivation. What's the user-visible problem? If the
feature is event-day critical, say so. -->

## Current workaround

<!-- If there's a way to do this today (e.g., by editing a
config file, by running a different command), describe it.
The team triages "no workaround" higher than "manual
workaround exists." -->

## Sketch

<!-- Optional. A code snippet, a doc reference, or a link to the
relevant section of ARCHITECTURE.md. Skip this if you don't
know what the implementation would look like. -->

```python
# something like this
```

## Affected files

<!-- Best guess at the files that would change. Helps the team
estimate the size. -->

- [ ] `apps/laptop/shruti_array/...`
- [ ] `apps/android/...`
- [ ] `docs/...`
- [ ] `tools/...`

## Scope

- [ ] Pre-event (can ship before the hackathon)
- [ ] On-site (event-day work)
- [ ] Post-event (nice to have, not blocking)

## Risks

<!-- What could this break? If you can think of a downside,
the team wants to know. -->
